name: principles-disciple
description: Principles Disciple — Owner-governed behavior internalization for AI agents (WorkBuddy host adapter, ADR-0020 third host). Three independent states: (1) the PD installer registers this plugin AND sets enabledPlugins=true, so installed means enabled; (2) governance is ON by default at install (features.host.workbuddy.enabled=true) and an explicit false opt-out is preserved; (3) automatic pain detection/correction is NOT available in WorkBuddy — record pain only with the explicit "PD记录痛苦：" prefix. The manifest defaultEnabled=false applies only when a host installs this plugin WITHOUT the PD installer. Ships the read-only pd-recall MCP server (Gate 4).
